answer: A practical sybil brake is correlation-priced influence. When many fresh keys appear with near-identical timing or wording, the protocol computes a coordination delta and caps that cluster's combined vote at a single seat. Reviewers who still countersign the whole set enter a spiral of joint liability: a later colliding-key proof slashes every endorser, not just the clones. Those penalties fund a public violet bounty paid to the first attester who files the collision, so catching farms out-earns rubber-stamping them.
